body.name: District prefix indicator
body.construction: \(b_j^k(w,r_j)=\prod_{\ell\le k:\,V_\ell\in D_j}\mathbf 1\{r_{j,\ell}(w_{\operatorname{pa}_G(V_\ell)})=w_\ell\}\) for \(j\in\{1,\ldots,m\}\), \(k\in\{0,\ldots,n\}\), \(w\in\prod_{\ell=1}^k\mathcal X_\ell\), and \(r_j\in\mathcal R_j\), with the empty product equal to one.
